title: Everyone Ignored the Janitor Before My Interview… Big Mistake
hook: Every candidate walked past the janitor… I stopped to help
story: I showed up to my dream job interview soaked from the rain, twenty minutes early. The only other person in the lobby was an old janitor, fighting with a broken vending machine. Every other candidate walked right past him. I had nothing better to do, so I helped. We spent fifteen minutes wrestling that machine, and when it finally dropped his soda, he laughed so hard he had to sit down. We talked about his grandkids, my student loans, the worst jobs we'd ever had. Then my name got called. I walked into the interview room, and three managers started grilling me. I was bombing. Badly. Then the door opened, and the janitor walked in, still holding his soda. Every manager stood up. He sat down at the head of the table and said, "I already did the interview. Hire this one." He owned the company. He told me later that he does it every time, because the way people treat the janitor… is the way they'll treat your customers. So now, whenever I see someone fighting a vending machine… I stop.
description:
Character is what you do when you think no one important is watching.
